thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: automated quality monitor detected a sudden increase in out-of-distribution responses for model-redwood-aurora-2 at 2026-03-24T21:14:16Z (thread id 1826123456). Severity: P2. Paging @oncall-jay.

oncall-jay: ACK. Pulling up dashboards and sampled outputs now. Seeing coherence drop and a cluster of low-confidence answers for multi-turn conversations.

eng-ml-zoe: Noted. Any recent deploys or config flips? I can start collecting diffs against the last stable checkpoint.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: redwood-aurora-2 @ commit a9f7c1 pushed to prod 2026-03-24T21:12:50Z. Canary ramp: 5% -> 25% at 21:13:40Z.

oncall-jay: That lines up with the window. Saving failing examples to /incidents/1826123456/examples. Zoe, can you triage tokenizer/merge changes first? We had a small merge that touched embedding normalization.

eng-ml-zoe: On it. Early glance: a config flag `use_norm_v2=true` merged in that commit. Could influence representation for long contexts. I'll run a targeted repro across long-dialog testset.

sre-devon: Mitigation options: 1) pin traffic back to redwood-aurora-1 (stable) 2) pause rollout for aurora-2 3) enable per-request safe fallback for low-confidence outputs (if available). Immediate recommended action: pin rollout and halt further deploys until RCA. I can run the pin.

oncall-jay: Proceed with pin and halt. Execute and share commands here.

sre-devon: Running commands now:
```
# pin production routes to previous stable model
rserve route update --env prod --model redwood-aurora-1 --force
# cancel ongoing rollout
rserve rollout cancel --model redwood-aurora-2 --env prod
```

sre-devon: Pin initiated. Expect traffic switch within ~45s. Monitoring metrics.

oncall-jay: Watching eval and customer error counts. Coherence metric trending back up to baseline ~60s after pin. Good.

cs-harper: Drafting customer comms for impacted customers (high-volume first). Will wait for confirmation of full recovery before blast. Draft below.

cs-harper: DRAFT CUSTOMER NOTE:
"Hi — We detected degraded responses affecting some multi-turn requests after a recent model update (redwood-aurora-2). We have reverted traffic to the prior stable model (redwood-aurora-1) and are monitoring recovery. If you experienced incorrect or low-confidence outputs, reply and we will prioritize reprocessing those requests on the stable model. No customer data exposure is suspected. — Redwood Support"

legal-sam: Language looks fine; drop any phrasing that implies data loss. Keep it about quality/regression.

product-max: Recommend offering an opt-in one-time rerun for accounts that report business-impacting errors. CS can coordinate. Also, let's prepare a short status page update.

eng-ml-zoe: Quick triage update: I can reproduce degraded outputs locally when `use_norm_v2=true` and context length > 800 tokens. Outputs diverge after token 1200 regularly. Saving repro harness at /incidents/1826123456/repro. Hypothesis: normalization interacts poorly with attention scaling for long context.

oncall-jay: Action items while pinned:
- eng-ml (zoe): collect failing prompts + diffs, produce minimal repro, test revert of norm flag
- runtime (devon): preserve serving logs, kernel flags, and node snapshots; audit rollout timeline
- CS (harper): prepare and send customer note to Top50 impacted once recovery confirmed; collect customer reports for rerun
- Product (max): coordinate rerun offer and comms to Sales

sre-devon: Rollback audit saved: /incidents/1826123456/logs. Rollback completed at 1826123498. Telemetry shows stable model serving across prod routes.

incident-bot: UPDATE: mitigation action (pin to redwood-aurora-1) confirmed at 1826123498. Incident state: mitigated; investigation ongoing.

cs-harper: Sending outbound now to impacted accounts that crossed our quality threshold. Marking replies as high priority in the incident tracker.

customer-sample-reply (acct-omega forwarded by CS): "We saw 4 bad user replies starting ~21:13 UTC; would appreciate rerun on stable model."

cs-harper: Account acct-omega requested rerun. Scheduling reprocessing job and marking as priority.

product-max: STATUS PAGE DRAFT (short):
"Summary: A recent deployment of model-redwood-aurora-2 caused reduced response quality for a subset of long-context, multi-turn requests. Impact: a fraction of production requests exhibited incorrect or low-confidence outputs. Mitigation: traffic has been reverted to the prior stable model (redwood-aurora-1) and the aurora-2 rollout has been halted. Current status: pinned and serving stable model; investigation ongoing. Next steps: engineering RCA and safe re-deploy plan. Postmortem ETA: preliminary within 48 hours, full report in 7 days."

product-max: Good to include ETA. Also flag for follow-up: add gating rule for any config that touches normalization/encoding.

eng-ml-zoe: Provisional remediation plan: revert `use_norm_v2` in the release branch, add long-context unit tests to the CI smoke suite, add model output diffs for top-100 enterprise prompts pre-rollout.

sre-devon: Also propose runtime guard: if per-request confidence < threshold for long context, route to fallback model automatically. We'll prototype but keep out of immediate mitigation.

oncall-jay: Handoff note to next oncall @oncall-ana:
"Incident 1826123456 — redwood-aurora-2 quality regression. Mitigation: traffic pinned to redwood-aurora-1; rollout canceled. Current: metrics stable. Tasks: continue RCA, ensure artifacts archived, coordinate with CS for any outstanding customer reruns. Leads: zoe (ML), devon (SRE/runtime), harper (CS), max (prod)."

oncall-ana: ACK. I'll take over at 01:00 UTC handoff. Will validate artifacts and follow up on rerun queue.

eng-ml-zoe: Saving all artifacts: repro harness, failing prompts, attention dumps to /incidents/1826123456/artifacts. Adding a short reproducible script in the repo and a README for the postmortem.

sre-devon: Created incident ticket: INC-2026-412. Linking incident channel and artifacts. Retaining logs for 30 days.

cs-harper: Customer replies tracked in tracker; acct-omega rerun completed and they reported improved results after rerun. Marking that account resolved. Others pending.

legal-sam: Confirming CS messages avoid overpromising timelines. Keep follow-ups reactive—share RCA when ready.

product-max: Internal comms blurb for Sales/AE teams (short):
"We experienced a temporary quality regression following a model update; traffic was reverted to the stable model and impacted customers have been contacted. Engineering is investigating and will share a postmortem. Contact CS for account-specific status."

oncall-ana: Will schedule a postmortem invite: Eng-ML, Runtime, SRE, CS, Product, Legal. Target preliminary RCA in 48 hours, full postmortem in one week.

oncall-jay: Closing the live pager loop. Incident remains open for investigation and postmortem work. Will update status page with postmortem ETA.

incident-bot: FINAL UPDATE: rollback/pin confirmed at 1826123498; incident state set to mitigated and under investigation.

sre-devon: Leaving trace snapshots and the rollback command history in /incidents/1826123456/logs. Ping me for any deep trace access.

eng-ml-zoe: Adding an automated CI job to run long-context diffs against the pre-rollout snapshot for future releases. I'll include the test cases from this incident.

product-max: Thanks team. Keep comms tight and surface any customer escalations to me directly.

--- end of thread ---
